title.zh-CN: 工人放置与位置占用
title.en: Worker placement and occupied spaces

summary.zh-CN: 走完两次放置，再只改位置容量：看清合法选项、先后顺序和资源结果的关系。
summary.en: Resolve two placements, then change only space capacity to examine legal options, turn order, and resource outcomes.

title.zh-CN: 牌库构筑与循环
title.en: Deck building and card cycles

summary.zh-CN: 跟踪一张新牌进入手牌、弃牌堆和下一次重洗的时点，比较获得位置怎样改变三轮产出。
summary.en: Track a new card through hands, discards, and reshuffles, then compare how its destination changes three rounds of output.

title.zh-CN: 同时选择与依次结算
title.en: Simultaneous choices, sequential resolution

summary.zh-CN: 三名信使先选去向，再依次领取有限包裹：分开决定、揭示和结算，比较承诺时点。
summary.en: Three couriers choose destinations before collecting limited packages in order. Compare choosing, revealing, and resolving.

title.zh-CN: 继续冒险，还是现在收手
title.en: Push your luck, or stop now

summary.zh-CN: 用六片不放回的抽取袋，比较停手、失败清空与较小损失，说明概率和期望值的前提。
summary.en: Use a six-token bag without replacement to compare stopping, losing everything, and taking a smaller loss, with explicit probability assumptions.

title.zh-CN: 拍卖：报价、获胜与付款
title.en: Auctions: bids, winners, and payments

summary.zh-CN: 用同一组报价比较两种付款规则，追踪剩余预算，并处理平手与全员不参加。
summary.en: Compare two payment rules with fixed bids, track remaining budgets, and resolve ties and all-pass outcomes.

title.zh-CN: 区域多数与计分时点
title.en: Area majority and scoring time

summary.zh-CN: 走完两处花园的最后三次放置，再只改平手规则，区分最多、排他控制和最终收益。
summary.en: Resolve three final placements in two gardens, then change only ties to distinguish influence, exclusive control, and rewards.

title.zh-CN: 看见机制：先说清这一步改变了什么
title.en: See a mechanism: explain what this step changes

summary.zh-CN: 走完两次包裹领取，只改卡是否被拿走，区分题材、组件、选择和规则关系。
summary.en: Resolve two parcel picks and change whether cards leave the supply to distinguish theme, components, decisions, and rules.

title.zh-CN: 选机制：先比较它们怎样解决同一个问题
title.en: Choose a mechanism: compare how it solves the same problem

summary.zh-CN: 用相同包裹和时间片比较免费取选与秘密报价，核算分配、付款与剩余资源的价值。
summary.en: Compare free selection and secret bids with the same parcels and tokens, accounting for allocation, payment, and leftovers.

title.zh-CN: 接起机制：拿到东西以后，规则接着做什么
title.en: Connect mechanisms: what happens after you acquire something?

summary.zh-CN: 追踪红蓝卡的取得与交付，再只改交付时点，看清材料、条件、次数与结束怎样连接。
summary.en: Track acquiring and submitting red-blue sets, then move the submission check to examine conditions, limits, and the end of an action.

title.zh-CN: 从题材到规则：把“先准备，才能启用”写出来
title.en: From Theme to Rule: Making “Prepare Before Use” Work

summary.zh-CN: 用两盏灯比较逐盏与整批检查，把题材关系写成动作条件、范围和时间代价。
summary.en: Compare checking lanterns individually or as a batch to turn a thematic relationship into action conditions, scope, and time costs.

title.zh-CN: 主题的承诺：回到营地，就一定算完成了吗？
title.en: A Theme's Promise: Does Reaching Camp Mean You Are Done?

summary.zh-CN: 比较回营后等待与登记的结果，分清题材预期、实际效果和规则改动。
summary.en: Compare waiting or recording after returning to camp, separating thematic expectations, actual effects, and rule changes.

title.zh-CN: 比较两款游戏：出牌前，玩家究竟知道什么？
title.en: Compare two games: what does the player know before playing?

summary.zh-CN: 固定一次出牌，比较6 nimmt!的23/35分支与Hanabi的两种提示：区分未知行动、未知牌面和成功后的推断。
summary.en: Hold a play fixed across 6 nimmt! and Hanabi to compare unknown actions, unknown card faces, and what success cannot establish.

title.zh-CN: 动物主题：谁在行动，谁只是被我们看见？
title.en: Animal Themes: Who Acts, and Who Is Being Observed?

summary.zh-CN: 用两轮狐狸与水獭记录比较重复拍摄和完整覆盖，区分玩家角色、动物对象与生态模拟。
summary.en: Compare repeated photographs with complete fox-and-otter coverage to distinguish player roles, animal subjects, and ecological simulation.

title.zh-CN: 交通与运输：路程更短，为什么准时分反而更少？
title.en: Transportation: Why Can the Shorter Trip Earn Fewer On-Time Points?

summary.zh-CN: 比较一辆货车的两种配送次序，算清装卸、行程、截止时点和准时奖励。
summary.en: Compare two delivery orders for one truck, accounting for handling, travel, deadlines, and punctuality rewards.

title.zh-CN: 行动选择：一个动作为什么现在能选、等会儿却不能？
title.en: Action selection: why is an action available now but unavailable later?

summary.zh-CN: 用四次电台行动区分素材费用与卡片资格，比较收回、连续使用和起始素材的影响。
summary.en: Use four radio actions to separate material costs from card access, comparing retrieval, repeat use, and starting material.

title.zh-CN: 行动点：预算够不够，还要看先后顺序
title.en: Action points: a sufficient budget still needs the right order

summary.zh-CN: 用两回合观测路线核算行动预算，比较未用点是否保留，并分清可行路线与最高分。
summary.en: Budget two observatory turns, compare point carryover, and distinguish feasible routes from the highest score.

title.zh-CN: 手牌管理：这张牌现在用，下一轮还剩什么？
title.en: Hand Management: What Will Be Left After You Play This Card?

summary.zh-CN: 用三轮工具卡工作比较用牌、留牌与补牌时点，分清手里有牌和此刻能做什么。
summary.en: Compare using, keeping, and replenishing three tool cards across three jobs to distinguish holding cards from having usable options.

title.zh-CN: 轮抽：我拿走这一张，谁的选择变了？
title.en: Drafting: Whose Options Change When I Take This Card?

summary.zh-CN: 三人按不同需要分六张牌，只改第二轮顺序，追踪剩余机会、分数与截走他人所需的代价。
summary.en: Three players with different needs divide six cards. Reverse only the second-round order to trace availability, scores, and the cost of denial.

title.zh-CN: 袋构筑：添进一种人手，下一轮就更顺吗？
title.en: Bag Building: Does Adding a Specialist Make the Next Round Better?

summary.zh-CN: 用两轮工坊看添人、回袋与永久移出怎样改变组合机会，并区分已经抽到两枚后的概率和整轮概率。
summary.en: Follow a two-round workshop to see how adding, returning and permanently removing crew changes combinations, and why conditional chances differ from whole-round chances.

title.zh-CN: 集合收集：同一枚图案，为什么会突然更值钱？
title.en: Set Collection: Why Can the Same Motif Suddenly Be Worth More?

summary.zh-CN: 比较最后一枚月亮和叶子，分别核算同类计分、齐全奖励与提交消耗怎样改变价值。
summary.en: Compare a final Moon or Leaf, calculating how matching groups, completion bonuses, and submission costs change their value.

title.zh-CN: 独占还是付费共用：后手还剩哪些选择？
title.en: Exclusive or shared for a fee: what can the next player still choose?

summary.zh-CN: 比较印刷台独占与付费共用，逐项核对进入资格、付款去向和最终净分数。
summary.en: Compare exclusive and paid access to a printing bench, checking eligibility, payment recipients, and net points.

title.zh-CN: 牌库换成袋子，会更随机吗？先看何时放回
title.en: Does replacing a deck with a bag add randomness? Check when items return

summary.zh-CN: 固定四件素材，先证明两种容器可有相同机会，再比较每轮放回怎样改变两轮结果。
summary.en: Hold four materials fixed, establish equivalent draw chances, then compare how returning items each round changes the two-round outcomes.

title.zh-CN: 区域控制：人离开以后，这里还算谁的？
title.en: Area control: who owns a place after the piece leaves?

summary.zh-CN: 比较保留所属标记与必须驻留，分开人物位置、控制权和结束收益。
summary.en: Compare retained ownership with required presence, separating piece locations, control, and final rewards.

title.zh-CN: 路线建造：为什么一段连接能服务多个目标？
title.en: Route building: why can one connection serve several goals?

summary.zh-CN: 用三次建设比较分支与延伸，再只改目标能否共享连接，核算同一网络的不同收益。
summary.en: Compare branching and extending over three construction actions, then change whether goals may share links.

title.zh-CN: 板块放置：这一块接得上，下一块还放得下吗？
title.en: Tile placement: this tile fits, but what about the next one?

summary.zh-CN: 用两块道路区分合法相邻与连续连接，再改变终点开口，检查现有材料是否足够。
summary.en: Use two road tiles to separate legal adjacency from connectivity, then change the destination opening to test the tile supply.

title.zh-CN: 骰子分配：最大的点数该单独用，还是留给组合？
title.en: Dice allocation: use the highest value alone, or save it for a combination?

summary.zh-CN: 分配已知的1、3、5，比较单枚收益与组合条件，再改变所需总和，检查余骰用途。
summary.en: Allocate known results of 1, 3, and 5, comparing individual rewards with combination requirements and the uses of leftover dice.

title.zh-CN: 隐藏信息：花钱看见以后，谁还来得及行动？
title.en: Hidden information: after paying to look, who can still act?

summary.zh-CN: 用三张订单比较不看、付费私看与付费公开，追踪信息受众、承诺时点及剩余的钱。
summary.en: Compare blind choices, paid private inspection, and paid public information using three orders, tracking commitment and retained coins.

title.zh-CN: 交流限制：只能问一次，“不是这里”究竟告诉了你什么？
title.en: Communication limits: with one question, what does “not here” tell you?

summary.zh-CN: 跟踪三处目的地的一次问答，再只增加提问上限，区分已经排除、仍须猜测与真正确定。
summary.en: Follow one question about three destinations, then raise only the question limit to distinguish elimination, guessing, and certainty.

title.zh-CN: 同样占了三个地点：看区域多数，还是看是否连成一片？
title.en: Owning three locations: count an area majority, or a connected group?

summary.zh-CN: 固定五个地点和两次放置，只改多数与最大连通部分计分，说明拥有数量与连接关系的差异。
summary.en: Hold five locations and two placements fixed, changing only majority versus largest-component scoring to compare ownership counts and connectivity.

title.zh-CN: 先揭示，还是先承诺：后结算的人就能后决定吗？
title.en: Reveal first or commit first: does resolving later mean choosing later?

summary.zh-CN: 用两场地的四组选择分开承诺、揭示和结算，比较提前知情与颠倒处理顺序各改变什么。
summary.en: Use four venue-choice pairs to separate commitment, revelation, and resolution, comparing earlier information with reversed processing order.

title.zh-CN: 公共资源：同一堆材料，谁拿走后归谁？
title.en: Shared resources: who owns a material after taking it?

summary.zh-CN: 用四次取料追踪公共供给如何变成私人得分，只改单次上限比较分配结果。
summary.en: Track common supply becoming private points over four actions, changing only the collection limit.

title.zh-CN: 资源转换：加工一块板，究竟放弃了什么？
title.en: Resource conversion: what does making a plank give up?

summary.zh-CN: 用加工、造船与出售三条配方比较材料和行动的共同成本。
summary.en: Compare processing, building, and selling while counting both materials and actions.

title.zh-CN: 收入与生产：同样结算两次，钱来得及时吗？
title.en: Income and production: does the money arrive in time?

summary.zh-CN: 只移动每轮收入的结算时点，追踪升级与配送为何在期限前可做或不可做。
summary.en: Move only income timing and track which upgrades and deliveries remain possible before the deadline.

title.zh-CN: 市场定价：买两件时，两件都按原价算吗？
title.en: Market pricing: do both items cost the starting price?

summary.zh-CN: 固定两位买家与四件货，只改整笔报价或逐件涨价，比较预算、库存与得分。
summary.en: Keep two buyers and four goods fixed, changing batch versus per-item repricing to compare affordability, stock, and scores.

title.zh-CN: 交易：价值都公开，也可能双方受益吗？
title.en: Trading: can both players benefit when values are public?

summary.zh-CN: 用全部公开的配方展示互利交换，再分开合法交易、双方增益与实际接受。
summary.en: Use public recipes to distinguish a legal exchange, gains for both players, and actual acceptance.

title.zh-CN: 合作结构：一起获胜，谁有权花这份材料？
title.en: Cooperative structure: who may spend the materials if everyone wins together?

summary.zh-CN: 用总量够却付不出的合作局面，分清共同胜负、资源权限与行动决定权。
summary.en: Use a collectively sufficient but unpayable task to distinguish shared victory, resource access, and decision authority.

title.zh-CN: 现在停，还是多掷一枚？掷完还要决定放哪里
title.en: Stop now or roll one more? You still have to place the dice afterward

summary.zh-CN: 把冒险收集与已知骰面分配放进同一阶段，只改失败损失，比较可用结果与平均分。
summary.en: Combine risky collection with known-result allocation, changing only failure losses and comparing outcomes and means.

title.zh-CN: 谁赢得拍品，谁需要付款？输家预算也会改变
title.en: Who wins the lot, and who pays? The loser's next move can change too

summary.zh-CN: 保持报价和拍品不变，只改落标者是否付款，追踪随后能否购买与最终计分。
summary.en: Keep bids and the lot fixed, changing only loser payment and following later affordability and final scoring.

title.zh-CN: 观察一次行动：先记发生了什么，再解释为什么
title.en: Observe a turn: record the event before explaining why it happened

summary.zh-CN: 用两条送书路线区分事件记录、规则后果和玩家意图，并核算一次提前出发是否还能补救。
summary.en: Compare two delivery traces to separate events, rule consequences, and player intent, calculating whether an early departure can be recovered.

title.zh-CN: 独立读规则：一句“卸书”，还缺哪个决定？
title.en: Read rules independently: what is missing from “unload books”?

summary.zh-CN: 用车载两本书的局面揭示动作数量缺失，比较口头补充与可独立使用的规则修订。
summary.en: Use two books aboard to expose a missing action quantity, comparing oral clarification with a revision readers can use independently.

title.zh-CN: 改一条规则：多给一次行动，究竟容许哪种失误？
title.en: Change one rule: which mistake does one extra action forgive?

summary.zh-CN: 固定送书路线，只把期限从6次改为7次，区别等待余量与绕路成本，并检查最后决定权。
summary.en: Change only the deadline from six to seven actions, distinguishing a spare wait from detour costs and checking who gets the final turn.

title.zh-CN: 为参与而设计：看得出选项，还要能表达自己的决定
title.en: Design for participation: recognizing options is only part of making a decision

summary.zh-CN: 把颜色提示、动作条件和代摆决定权分开，比较哪些信息保留下来，哪些参与问题仍需实测。
summary.en: Separate color prompts, action conditions, and assisted-placement authority, identifying preserved information and remaining questions for observation.

title.zh-CN: 按问题做原型：这次需要保留哪些细节？
title.en: Prototype for a question: which details must remain this time?

summary.zh-CN: 用完整可打印的小车游戏比较6步与5步，再检查删掉中间地点为什么会改变所测问题。
summary.en: Use a complete printable cart game to compare six and five actions, then examine why removing an intermediate location changes the question.

title.zh-CN: 使用反馈：一句“加本书”，还不是修订结论
title.en: Use feedback: “add a book” is not yet a revision decision

summary.zh-CN: 从虚构反馈中分开体验与建议，核算加一本书和一次卸完的代价，再决定下一次查什么。
summary.en: Separate reaction from suggestion in a fictional feedback scenario, calculate adding a book versus unloading all, and choose the next question.

title.zh-CN: 环境与生态：取走多少以后，还能继续恢复？
title.en: Environmental themes: what must remain for recovery to continue?

summary.zh-CN: 用两轮采集与再生比较眼前收获、共同余量和阈值后果。
summary.en: Compare immediate harvest, retained stock, and recovery thresholds across two rounds.

title.zh-CN: 农业与农场：成熟了，为什么还没有收获？
title.en: Farming: why does a mature crop still yield nothing?

summary.zh-CN: 把生长等待与收获行动分开，比较最后一轮继续播种和及时收获。
summary.en: Separate growth from harvesting and compare planting again with collecting a mature crop.

title.zh-CN: 城市建设：建筑数量相同，谁能用上服务？
title.en: City building: the same buildings, but who can use the services?

summary.zh-CN: 相同住宅、公园与市场，换个位置就改变服务覆盖；同时检查谁拥有规划权。
summary.en: Rearrange identical houses and facilities to change coverage while examining who controls planning.

title.zh-CN: 工业与制造：为什么还有零件，却做不出成品？
title.en: Industry and manufacturing: why can't a spare part become a finished product?

summary.zh-CN: 沿原料—零件—成品追踪库存，比较直接生产和先改装设备的时间与能源代价。
summary.en: Trace raw materials, parts, and products to compare immediate production with an equipment modification.

title.zh-CN: 探索与考察：先知道障碍，还是先准备跨过去？
title.en: Exploration: learn about the obstacle, or prepare to cross it?

summary.zh-CN: 在两个未知站点比较勘查、准备绳具和直接出发，检查成果何时才算交回。
summary.en: Compare surveying, equipping, and departing directly while distinguishing return from submission.

title.zh-CN: 奇幻：能瞬移到塔顶，为什么还是交不了信物？
title.en: Fantasy: why can't you deliver the token after teleporting to the tower?

summary.zh-CN: 比较步行与瞬移，明确能力改变的位置、消耗的魔力和尚未解除的封印。
summary.en: Compare walking and teleportation by tracking location, mana, and the ward that remains closed.

title.zh-CN: 科幻：发出指令时看到的，还会是执行时的位置吗？
title.en: Science fiction: will the target still be there when the command executes?

summary.zh-CN: 用公开目标程序比较即时反应与两轮后的执行，解释指令承诺、延迟和结束。
summary.en: Compare reactions to current positions with two-round-delayed execution and the end-of-game deadline.

title.zh-CN: 中世纪题材：手里有货，谁才有权进集市？
title.en: Medieval themes: goods in hand, but who may enter the market?

summary.zh-CN: 比较保留与转交集市凭证，分清有货、有钱与拥有行动权限。
summary.en: Compare retaining and transferring a market pass to distinguish goods, money, and permission.

title.zh-CN: 医疗与公共健康：排进时段，为什么还没有获得服务？
title.en: Medical and public-health themes: a time slot is not yet a completed service

summary.zh-CN: 让预约时段与翻译支持对齐，区分已经安排、实际完成与尚未满足的需求。
summary.en: Align consultation slots with interpretation support to distinguish scheduling from completion.

title.zh-CN: 悬疑与谜案：得到两条回答，就排除了两次吗？
title.en: Mystery: do two answers eliminate possibilities twice?

summary.zh-CN: 比较重复回答与有效排除，让线索数量和真正缩小的候选范围分别可见。
summary.en: Compare redundant answers with discriminating clues by tracking the remaining candidates.

title.zh-CN: 不确定环境中的考察：队友的回程信息，什么时候有用？
title.en: An expedition: when does a teammate's return information matter?

summary.zh-CN: 让两位队员分别掌握记录价值和返程费用，比较前进与及时返回。
summary.en: Give teammates separate record-value and return-cost information, then compare advancing with returning.

title.zh-CN: 社区厨房：做成两碗，为什么还有一种需求没被回应？
title.en: Community kitchen: two bowls cooked, but one need remains unmet

summary.zh-CN: 沿备料、烹饪、分发追踪劳动，比较重复产量与不同需求的完成。
summary.en: Track preparation, cooking, and distribution to distinguish repeated output from meeting different needs.

title.zh-CN: 档案馆：都保留两张，能回答的为什么不是同一个问题？
title.en: The archive: two records kept, but different questions answered

summary.zh-CN: 比较两组同分的保存选择，检查留下哪些证据链与可回答问题。
summary.en: Compare equal-scoring preservation choices by tracing the evidence chains and queries they support.

title.zh-CN: 共同水域：看起来恢复了，还欠着下一轮的后果吗？
title.en: Shared waters: the condition looks restored, but are consequences still pending?

summary.zh-CN: 让相同采集与修复次数产生不同终值，追踪最后一轮仍待兑现的环境后果。
summary.en: Reorder identical collection and restoration actions while tracking effects pending beyond the final action round.

title.zh-CN: 老屋修复：两间最终都修好，中途也能继续使用吗？
title.en: Restoring an occupied building: both rooms repaired, but usable throughout?

summary.zh-CN: 对比同时开工与逐间修复，逐步检查终局成果之外的持续使用条件。
summary.en: Compare overlapping and staggered work by checking continued use as well as final repairs.

title.zh-CN: 街区节日：节目都演完了，公共收尾由谁承担？
title.en: A neighborhood festival: the shows are over, but who handles the shared wrap-up?

summary.zh-CN: 比较四次行动中的宣传、演出与收尾，让公共工作及其承担者可见。
summary.en: Fit promotion, performances, and wrap-up into four actions while making shared labor and its participants visible.

title.zh-CN: 断续通信：正确物资晚一轮出发，还能及时交接吗？
title.en: Intermittent communication: can the right supplies leave one round late?

summary.zh-CN: 把一条需求消息与两轮物资交接结合，区分先知道、先发送和实际送达。
summary.en: Connect a need report with two transfer rounds to distinguish knowing, dispatching, and arrival.

title.zh-CN: 学徒工坊：成品都有了，谁真正做过自己的工序？
title.en: Apprenticeship: the products exist, but who practiced their own task?

summary.zh-CN: 比较代做与先示范，分别记录技能、作品作者和本人实践机会。
summary.en: Compare proxy making with demonstration first, tracking skills, authorship, and personal practice separately.

title.zh-CN: 一小块城市空间：休息点放好了，谁的路径变长了？
title.en: A small urban space: a resting place added, but whose journey becomes longer?

summary.zh-CN: 用两位使用者的完整路径比较长椅位置，分别保留通行和休息条件。
summary.en: Trace two users’ routes around alternative bench positions, keeping passage and rest requirements separate.

title.zh-CN: 共同用水：第一季可行的配额，第二季还能满足需要吗？
title.en: Shared water: can last season's allocation cap meet this season's needs?

summary.zh-CN: 比较两季固定与修订上限，分清合法取用、下游余量与承诺是否可执行。
summary.en: Compare fixed and revised seasonal caps, separating legal withdrawals, downstream availability, and enforceable promises.

title.zh-CN: 照应安排：时间变少之后，谁能同意接手？
title.en: A care schedule: when time shrinks, who agrees to take over?

summary.zh-CN: 在可用时间变化后重新检查分配，只有接收者同意才转交任务。
summary.en: Recheck an allocation after availability changes and transfer a task only with the recipient’s agreement.

title.zh-CN: 社区修理：症状相同，就能复制上一次修法吗？
title.en: Repair café: the same symptom, so can the previous method be copied?

summary.zh-CN: 比较分别检查与照搬修法，追踪失败提供的信息和不可退还的材料。
summary.en: Compare checking each object with repeating a method, tracking information gained and materials spent on failure.

title.zh-CN: 行动编程：排好顺序，不等于每一步都能成功
title.en: Action programming: a planned sequence does not guarantee successful steps

summary.zh-CN: 两人预先排好三张行动卡，追踪共享扣件的去向，比较顺序与失败后取消余下动作的结果。
summary.en: Two players program three cards. Track shared fasteners and compare sequencing with cancellation after a failed action.

title.zh-CN: 时间轨：这次走多远，决定下次谁行动
title.en: Time track: how far you move decides who acts next

summary.zh-CN: 用三张工单算完两条时间轨路线，只改同格时谁先行动，观察费用如何改变后续分配。
summary.en: Resolve two routes through three job cards, then change only tie priority to see how time costs affect later allocation.

title.zh-CN: 多用途卡牌：用来筹钱的展台，还能建设吗？
title.en: Multi-Use Cards: Can a Display Used for Funding Still Be Built?

summary.zh-CN: 走完三张布展牌的两种筹款与建设路线，再只改用途互斥规则，核对设施、钱币和失去的机会。
summary.en: Compare two funding and construction routes for three exhibition cards, then change only exclusivity and track structures, coins, and sacrificed options.

title.zh-CN: 吃墩：赢下这一墩，为什么可能让自己扣分？
title.en: Trick-Taking: Why Can Winning a Trick Cost You Points?

summary.zh-CN: 用完整九张牌比较跟色、王牌、胜墩与红牌扣分，再取消王牌，追踪每墩获牌者和下一位领出者。
summary.en: Use a complete nine-card deal to compare following suit, trumps, trick winners, and red-card penalties, then remove trumps and follow the next lead.

title.zh-CN: 移动点数：少走两段路，为什么还到不了？
title.en: Movement points: why can the shorter route leave you stranded?

summary.zh-CN: 用4点预算走两条长短不同的取样路线，只改地形费用，核算能否串起两份收益。
summary.en: Spend a four-point budget on two sampling routes, then change one terrain cost to see which rewards can be combined.

title.zh-CN: 控制区：棋子没站在路上，为什么也能拦住你？
title.en: Zones of control: how can a piece block a space it does not occupy?

summary.zh-CN: 让一名守卫影响周围空格，比较进入即停与进入加价，分清占位、影响和通行预算。
summary.en: Let one guard affect nearby empty spaces; compare forced stops with entry surcharges, separating occupation, influence, and budget.
